limitations: Includes screen capture overhead; pixel changes are not whole-window FPS.
Current runner had a one-second wheel-handler stall in one of three rounds.
No pixel updates in control rounds can indicate frozen composition; input dispatch still completed.
Previous reports used CLOCK_MONOTONIC against Wine CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW and inflated initial latency; these figures replace them.
